PM Modi considers social media age restrictions, citing Australia

Prime Minister Narendra Modi has indicated interest in implementing age restrictions for social media use in India, drawing a parallel with Australia's approach. This suggestion was made during a recent interaction, sparking discussion about potential policy changes regarding online platforms.
